description: This file defines a custom Android view called CardView that represents a flip-able card component with animations for flipping and rotating. It handles bitmap resources for front and back, applies flip animations, and maintains independent layout states after each animation.

classes.name: CardView
classes.description: A custom ImageView that supports horizontal flipping and rotation animations, managing front and back bitmaps, and handling layout updates after animations.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the CardView, loads front and back bitmaps, sets camera distance.

methods.name: bitmapWithBorder
methods.description: Wraps a drawable bitmap with a transparent border for anti-aliasing during rotation.

methods.name: flipRightToLeft
methods.description: Initiates a horizontal flip animation from right to left.

methods.name: flipLeftToRight
methods.description: Initiates a horizontal flip animation from left to right.

methods.name: flipHorizontally
methods.description: Performs the flip animation, toggles front/back images, and updates layout post-animation.

methods.name: setShadow
methods.description: Darkens the image to simulate a shadow during flip.

methods.name: toggleFrontShowing
methods.description: Switches the current visible bitmap between front and back.

methods.name: toggleIsHorizontallyFlipped
methods.description: Toggles the horizontally flipped state and invalidates the view.

methods.name: onSizeChanged
methods.description: Updates the flip matrix when view size changes.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Applies horizontal flip transformation if needed before drawing.

methods.name: updateLayoutParams
methods.description: Resets rotation values, maintains layout position after animation.

methods.name: updateDrawableBitmap
methods.description: Sets the image drawable to current front or back bitmap.

methods.name: updateTranslation
methods.description: Adjusts translation offsets based on pile position.

methods.name: getRotationAnimator
methods.description: Creates an animator for rotating the card around a corner.

methods.name: getFullRotationAnimator
methods.description: Creates an animator for a full 360-degree rotation with delay based on position.

methods.name: rotateCardAroundCorner
methods.description: Sets pivot points for rotation around specified corner.

methods.name: setCardFlipListener
methods.description: Assigns a listener for flip events.
